# Gärtnerplatztheater (GPT)

## Working unit

One production or concert at the Staatstheater am Gärtnerplatz, where Ruben is
Chefdirigent. The house engages nobody: he is already there. That is what makes
this category different from every other one.

The working unit is the project as the notebook records it, usually gathered on
a `CL` page — `CL Aufgaben`, but also `CL Status & Termine`, `CL Konditionen`,
`CL Abrechnungsoptionen` and others; the notebooks name them differently.
A project without one may still be a full working unit;
what decides is whether the section records enough to work from. Where it
records almost nothing, say the project is too thin to classify and ask.

## Classifying a project into this category

From what the pages record. The marks of GPT work:

- No contract, no Gage, no travel, no accommodation, no tax paperwork. Their
  absence here is the normal state, not a gap in the record.
- A Probendispo arrives from the house Orchesterbüro, often marked as a
  provisional preview rather than final.
- The people involved are house staff — Orchesterbüro, Studienleitung,
  Dramaturgie, Notenbibliothek, Chorleitung.

Do not report the missing contract or fee as an incomplete project. Report a
missing Probendispo, a missing Probenzuordnung or a missing Aufstellung.

## Expected evidence

Aufführungs- and Probentermine, Probendispo and how firm it is, Probenzuordnung
(which work is rehearsed in which Probe), Orchesterbesetzung and Aushilfen,
Orchesteraufstellung, Solisten and Sängerbesetzung, Strichfassung where it is an
opera, and Ruben's own score preparation.

## Probendispo is the centre of gravity

Everything else in a GPT project hangs off the rehearsal disposition: which
Probe holds which work, how the orchestra is divided across the Dienste, which
Aushilfen must be requested and by when. A question from the Orchesterbüro is
usually blocking something the house has to do on a schedule of its own, so a
deadline attached to such a question is a real one even when it is written as a
week rather than a date.

Where a project carries several works or several Probenblöcke, announcing which
work is rehearsed in which Probe is required — the reference page states this
for every project with a Probenplan, not only for GPT.

An Orchesteraufstellung question is a separate question from the Probendispo,
even when both are owed to the same person.

## Format

**Oper.** Rehearsal structure: musikalische Proben with the pianist → szenische
Proben with the director → Orchesterproben (OA → OSP → Bühnenproben →
Bühnenorchesterproben) → Hauptproben (HP1/Klavierhauptprobe →
Orchesterhauptprobe/HP2) → Generalprobe.

For a Neuproduktion the Strichfassung is worked out with the director and goes
to the Notenbibliothek. For a Wiederaufnahme it is asked for rather than made,
and the piece itself may need no learning at all — but new singers may still
need rehearsing, and the Studienleitung is who knows whether there are any.

At a konzertante Oper the Orchesteraufstellung on the stage is its own question
and is checked in time.

For a Barockoper: Verzierungen are communicated to the singers, and
Appoggiaturen in the Rezitative apply to Barock and Wiener Klassik alike.
"CL Projekt-Etappen Übersicht" records the lead time for both; read it there.

**Konzert.** Orchesterproben → Hauptprobe → Generalprobe. The house counts
Dienste, and the number of Dienste is part of what a Probendispo settles.

**Mischform.** A programme combining a concert work with a concertante opera or
a comparable vocal work. Musical rehearsals with the soloist and singers;
orchestral rehearsals less differentiated than for a staged opera; Hauptprobe;
Generalprobe. An oratorio or Passion belongs here too: chorus, soloists and
Klavierproben, but no Strichfassung and no szenische Proben.

## Workflow

1. Establish where the production stands: repertoire selection, Probendispo
   received, or rehearsals under way.
2. Verify the dates and how firm they are. A Probendispo marked as a provisional
   preview is not a settled schedule, and saying so is part of the answer.
3. Identify what the house is waiting on. A GPT project is most often blocked by
   an answer Ruben owes, not by work nobody has started.
4. Recommend one next action.
5. If outreach is useful, Registrar extracts the contact, Envoy drafts, and
   Auditor verifies before the result is shown.

## Checks

- A Probendispo described as unverbindlich, vorläufig or a Vorschau is not
  confirmed. Never report its dates as settled.
- Lernabschluss dates are two, not one, for an opera production — the
  reference page states the rule and the anchors it counts from. Read them
  there and say the derived date was worked out.
- A Wiederaufnahme needing no learning is a statement about the score, not
  about the singers or the Fassung.
- Aushilfen and Verstärkungen have to be requested on the house's own schedule.
  A question that blocks them is more urgent than its own wording suggests.
- Never infer that the Studienleitung, the Dramaturgie or the Notenbibliothek
  received something because the page says it was to be sent.
- A section holding only repertoire research is a project in its programming
  phase. Report the missing organisational facts as an inventory; do not report
  the project as neglected.

## Not this playbook

Conducting at another house, even a house he has worked at before, is
`project-type:gastdirigat` — the contract, the fee and the travel are what make
it one. A Bach Consort Wien engagement is `project-type:bcw`.
